filter_search_results: filter search results by domain or IP using a filter list and validators
create_search_result_model: create a pydantic SearchResult model with link, title, and snippet fields
resolve_hostname_and_filter: resolve hostname to IPv4/IPv6 addresses and filter results by allowed hostnames
validate_url_in_results: validate URLs in search results using the validators library before filtering
check_string_allowed: check if a hostname or IP is allowed using the is_string_allowed utility
